name: Jump-cancel shine
goal: Jump out of a dash and shine as you leave the ground.
why: A dash accepts no down-B, so a dashing Fox cannot shine directly. A jump can start out of the dash, and down-B pressed as that jump leaves the ground gives a shine at ground level that keeps part of the dash's momentum: the running shine that catches an opponent's dash or landing.

tutorial.what: A jump-cancelled shine is a jump out of a dash and down-B on frame {J+1}, the frame the jump squat ends. The shine stops Fox's rise on that frame, so it comes out at ground level and he lands in it {4} frames later.
tutorial.expect: Each attempt is judged when the shine comes out, or when Fox lands without one: whether the jump came out of a dash and on which frame the shine came. After misses, the coach shows your inputs frame by frame against these frames.

marks.1: Frame 1: X pressed during the dash. The jump squat begins
marks.J: Frame {J}: the last frame of the jump squat. Down-B now is ignored
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B as Fox leaves the ground. The shine at ground level
marks.J+5: Frame {J+5}: Fox lands in the shine

lessons.title: No shine from a dash
text: A dash accepts side-B but not down-B: down-B pressed while dashing does nothing. A run accepts it, but every run starts with a dash, and a jump can start out of the dash.

The jump squat accepts only a grab, an up smash and up-B: down-B pressed during the jump squat is ignored. On frame {J+1} Fox leaves the ground, and down-B on that frame is an aerial shine. It stops his rise before he has moved up, so the shine is at ground level and he lands in it {4} frames later, still shining.

marks.1: Frame 1: X pressed. The jump squat begins
marks.2: Frame {f}: jump squat. Down-B now is ignored
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B. The shine at ground level

lessons.title: One frame
lessons.text: Down-B has one frame, the first frame in the air. A frame later Fox has already risen {2} units, and the shine holds him there: he floats down in it for more than {20} frames instead of landing at once.

cue.words: Frame {J+1}: the shine at ground level

verdict.success: Jump-cancelled shine on frame {shine_frame}, at ground level.

out of a dash.expect: A jump out of a dash
out of a dash.words: the jump did not start from a dash
out of a dash.headline: No dash
out of a dash.fix: Dash first: tap the control stick fully to the side, then press X or Y while Fox is still dashing.

shined.expect: A shine out of the jump
shined.headline: No shine
shined.fix: Press down-B on frame {J+1}, the frame {char} leaves the ground. Down-B pressed during the jump squat is ignored.

first airborne frame.expect: Shine on frame {J+1}, the first frame in the air
first airborne frame.headline: Late shine
first airborne frame.fix: Press down-B {J} frames after the jump, as the jump squat ends. One frame later {char} has risen, and the shine stays in the air.

parts.name: Shine as you leave the ground
parts.teach: Standing, press X, then down-B on frame {J+1}, the frame the jump squat ends. The shine comes out at ground level.

marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B. Shine at ground level

coach.note: The jump squat is {J} frames: down-B on frame {J+1}.

parts.name: Out of a dash
parts.teach: Dash, press X during the dash, and down-B on frame {J+1}. Five in a row.

marks.1: Frame 1: X pressed during the dash
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B. Shine at ground level
marks.J+5: Frame {J+5}: landed in the shine, sliding

coach.note: The jump squat is {J} frames: down-B on frame {J+1}.
